query: What patient needs appear in visit notes?

per_column.name: clinical_problem_type
per_column.rationale: Categorizes the nature of patient need (acute vs chronic vs preventive etc.), a genuine grouping axis directly serving 'what patient needs appear.' Values are sound readings, though the annual physical labeled chronic_management is a mild stretch (arguably preventive), and MI follow-up as chronic is well-grounded.

per_column.name: acuity_and_threat
per_column.rationale: Adds a severity axis. Partially redundant with the existing 'urgency' column but offers a finer-grained clinical reading (e.g. acute_stable, life_threatening) beyond raw triage urgency, so it retains some leverage. Values align well with source text.

per_column.name: intervention_required
per_column.rationale: Captures what action the need calls for (pharmaceutical, imaging, procedural), a strong new axis for the query. Well grounded: doxycycline->pharmaceutical, MRI->imaging_diagnostic. Annual physical->pharmaceutical is slightly weak since labs were ordered, not clearly a drug, but broadly defensible.

per_column.name: anatomic_system_focus
per_column.rationale: Body-system categorization gives a clear grouping axis for patient needs. Values are well extracted from text (respiratory URI, cardiovascular MI, musculoskeletal knee, dermatologic acne).

per_column.name: care_coordination_requirement
per_column.rationale: Distinct downstream axis about follow-up/referral/admission needs, useful for the query. Values are warranted inferences (MRI to rule out tear->specialist_referral; return-if-worse URI->not_present; MI regimen continuation->long_term_followup).

judge.rationale: The added columns provide multiple genuinely distinct analytical axes (problem type, acuity, intervention, anatomic system, coordination) that each help answer what patient needs appear in visit notes. acuity_and_threat overlaps somewhat with the original urgency column but still adds clinical granularity. Values across sampled rows are sound extractions or well-warranted inferences from the reason_for_visit text, with only minor stretches (annual physical labeled chronic/pharmaceutical). No fabricated facts observed.
